The background remains constant with the blue neon lighting. (3) The man sits back and begins a vigorous beatbox performance, his mouth moving rapidly and his head bobbing in rhythm. audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A natural male voice with a casual tone initiates the conversation in Mandarin, asking if the other party can beatbox. The vocal delivery is clear and at a moderate conversational loudness. There is no background music, and the acoustic environment is a clean studio-like setting with very low ambient noise floor. (2) A sharp digital notification chime signals a response. An AI-synthesized male voice speaks with a very polite, flat, and professional tone. It expresses willingness to perform and then produces a series of slow, simple vocal percussions that lack the complexity of actual beatboxing. The sound is dry with no reverb. (3) The human male voice returns, proposing a beatbox battle with an enthusiastic and slightly competitive tone. The speech rate is moderate. After another digital chime, the AI voice agrees in its characteristically calm and submissive manner, setting the stage for the upcoming performance between the two entities. (4) The human male performs an intense, high-tempo beatbox sequence characterized by complex transients, sharp clicking sounds, and deep percussive thuds. The audio is high-energy with significant spectral flux. This is followed by a digital chime and the AI voice's calm praise and its own subsequent, low-effort beatbox attempt. (5) The human voice speaks with a teasing, dismissive tone, asking to end the call as if disappointed. The AI voice responds with a lengthy, formal, and philosophical speech about technological growth and feedback. The vocal intensity remains low until the human suddenly yells Shut up at a high volume, ending the track.
